figurative_meaning_en: fragile situation, precarious or dangerous condition
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের ব্যবসা এখন তাসের ঘরের মতো ভঙ্গুর।
রাজনৈতিক পরিস্থিতি তাসের ঘরের মতো অস্থির হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Their business is now as fragile as a house of cards.
The political situation has become as unstable as a house of cards.
note: The idiom draws from the universal image of a card house collapsing easily, adapted into Bengali linguistic usage.
